wires.helpComputers: Click a wire or dot to follow it. Click a shared bus or CPU wire to choose a connected part. Keyboard: Tab and Enter; ↑/k and ↓/j follow either end of a chip wire, ←/h and →/l either end of a maker wire.
wires.helpCards: With a card selected: ←/h and →/l move along its family line; ↑/k and ↓/j move between a chip and its computers.

legend.fineprint: Verification is recorded from explicit evidence in the linked issue. A closed issue is not a human approval. Era bands are narrative chapters; architectures and word widths overlap. A separate 18-bit prelude covers discrete-logic machines. Reconstruction wires identify later implementation parts, not original factory hardware. Dates distinguish introductions, documented bounds, previews and original system profiles. Open the “i” button on a card for date qualifications and photo credit; chips precede computers within the same year.
